This parameter is parsed in the qute_history function and passed to history_data. The value can be any floating-point number representing a timestamp, or it defaults to the current time if not provided.
predictions.sink_summary: The retrieved history entries are returned as JSON data containing URL, title, and timestamp information. This data is accessible via the qute://history/data endpoint and could potentially expose browsing history to users with access to this URL.

predictions.risk_pattern: Unvalidated timestamp parameter leads to potential information disclosure through history data retrieval
